set -euo pipefail; REF=9f7eeaf0ec16da00e6f5733aaf4f7b91884b213b; TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-qwen-threshold.XXXXXX); PID=''; cleanup(){ if [ -n "${PID:-}" ]; then kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$TMP/repo"; test "$(git -C "$TMP/repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$REF"; cd "$TMP/repo"; export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11439; ollama serve >"$TMP/ollama.log" 2>&1 & PID=$!; for i in $(seq 1 40); do ollama list >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.5; done; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess
import omega_grid_repo_snapshot as rs
import omega_unified_ingest as s
repo=pathlib.Path('.')
paths=[]
raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z'])
paths=[x.decode('utf-8','surrogateescape') for x in raw.split(b'\0') if x]
comp=s.OllamaCompressor('qwen2.5:0.5b',timeout=180)
for n in (1500,2500,4000,6000,8000,12000):
    text=rs._semantic_dossier(repo,paths,n)
    cap,used=comp.compress(text,{'repository':'gschaidergabriel/frankenstein','head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()})
    print(f'N={n} ACTUAL={len(text)} USED={used} SUMMARY={len(cap.get("summary",""))}')
print('OMEGA_QWEN_DOSSIER_THRESHOLD_PASS=1')
PY
